```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)  
library(dplyr)
```
  
```{r data}
# Filter data and create a dummy variable

orbis_panel_berlin <- readRDS("~/GitHub/rct25/data/generated/orbis_panel_berlin.rds")

# Define target postal code
target_postcode <- "13353"

# Filter data for the year 2021, exclude companies with no postcode information
orbis_2021 <- orbis_panel_berlin %>%
  filter(year == 2021, !is.na(postcode))

# Create a dummy variable:
# - 1 if the company is in the target postcode
# - 0 otherwise
orbis_2021 <- orbis_2021 %>%
  mutate(
    in_target = ifelse(postcode == target_postcode, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r equity ratio}
# Create equity ratio in each group 

# The equity ratio is calculated as shareholder funds (shfd) divided by total assets (toas)
# This represents the proportion of a company's assets financed by its own equity

# Create new variable: equity ratio 
# Keep only rows where equity ratio is not NA (i.e., both shfd and toas are available)

orbis_2021 <- orbis_2021 %>%
  mutate(
    equity_ratio = shfd / toas  
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(equity_ratio)       
  )

# Check the number of companies in each group
n_target <- sum(orbis_2021$in_target == 1)
n_other <- sum(orbis_2021$in_target == 0)
```

```{r stats}
# Summarize statistics by group using dummy variable

group_summary <- orbis_2021 %>%
  group_by(in_target) %>%  # Group by dummy variable (1 = target postcode, 0 = rest of Berlin)
  summarise(
    mean_toas = mean(toas, na.rm = TRUE),              # Mean of total assets
    sd_toas = sd(toas, na.rm = TRUE),                  # Standard deviation of total assets
    median_toas = median(toas, na.rm = TRUE),          # Median of total assets
    mean_equity = mean(equity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),    # Mean of equity ratio
    sd_equity = sd(equity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),        # Standard deviation of equity ratio
    median_equity = median(equity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE) # Median of equity ratio
  )

# View the result
#group_summary
```

```{r t test}
# Run Welch Two-Sample t-tests

# T-test for equity ratio
t_test_equity <- t.test(
  equity_ratio ~ in_target, 
  data = orbis_2021
)

# T-test for total assets
t_test_assets <- t.test(
  toas ~ in_target, 
  data = orbis_2021
)

# View results
#t_test_equity
#t_test_assets
```

```{r table}
# Create a final table  

# Helper function for formatting numbers with thousand separators
format_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  format(round(x, digits), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
}

# Create final summary table
final_table <- data.frame(
  Group = c(
    paste0("Firms in ", target_postcode, " (n=", n_target, ")"),
    paste0("Other Firms (n=", n_other, ")"),
    "p-value (Welch t-test)"
  ),
  Mean_toas = c(
    format_num(group_summary$mean_toas[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$mean_toas[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    format_num(t_test_assets$p.value, digits = 5)
  ),
  Median_toas = c(
    format_num(group_summary$median_toas[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$median_toas[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    "-"
  ),
  SD_toas = c(
    format_num(group_summary$sd_toas[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$sd_toas[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    "-"
  ),
  Mean_equity = c(
    format_num(group_summary$mean_equity[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$mean_equity[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    format_num(t_test_equity$p.value)
  ),
  Median_equity = c(
    format_num(group_summary$median_equity[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$median_equity[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    "-"
  ),
  SD_equity = c(
    format_num(group_summary$sd_equity[group_summary$in_target == 1]),
    format_num(group_summary$sd_equity[group_summary$in_target == 0]),
    "-"
  )
)
```

# **Table 6. Comparison of Total Assets and Equity Ratios — Postal Code 13353 vs. Rest of Berlin (2021)**

```{r render}
# Render the table with formatting

final_table %>%
  kbl(
    col.names = c("", "Mean", "Median", "SD", "Mean", "Median", "SD"),
    align = "lcccccc",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    format = "latex",
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(" " = 1, "Total Assets" = 3, "Equity Ratio" = 3),
  ) %>%
  column_spec(
    2:7, width = "2.5cm"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down", "threeparttable"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general = "Notes: The analysis is based on Orbis data on firms registered in Berlin. Total Assets (EUR) refers to the book value of all assets at fiscal year-end; Equity Ratio is defined as shareholder funds divided by total assets. The sample includes all Berlin firms with valid postal codes in 2021: n = 123 for postal code 13353 and n = 27,613 for other Berlin postal codes. Firms with missing postal codes are excluded. Welch two-sample t-tests are used to compare group means. The null hypothesis is that the group means are equal; the alternative hypothesis is that they are different. P-values are shown in the bottom row. A significance threshold of p = 0.05 is applied; p < 0.05 indicates a statistically significant difference.",
    general_title = "",
    threeparttable = TRUE
  )

```
